terms.title: Element
terms.definition: An HTML element is an individual component of an HTML document or web page.
terms.explanation: Elements are represented using opening tags, content, and closing tags.

terms.title: Attribute
terms.definition: Attributes provide additional information about HTML elements.
terms.explanation: They are always specified in the start tag and usually come in name/value pairs.

terms.title: Tag
terms.definition: A hidden keyword enclosed in angle brackets that formats page content.
terms.explanation: Most tags come in pairs: opening tags and closing tags.

terms.title: Doctype
terms.definition: An instruction to the web browser about what version of HTML the page is written in.
terms.explanation: It must be the very first line of code in an HTML document.

terms.title: Anchor
terms.definition: Defines a hyperlink that links one page to another.
terms.explanation: The most important attribute of the anchor element is the href attribute.

terms.title: Semantic HTML
terms.definition: HTML that introduces meaning to the web page rather than just presentation.
terms.explanation: Semantic tags clearly describe their meaning to both the browser and the developer.

terms.title: Header Tag
terms.definition: Represents introductory content or a set of navigational links.
terms.explanation: Typically contains heading elements, logos, or author information.

terms.title: Nav Tag
terms.definition: Defines a set of navigation links.
terms.explanation: Intended for major blocks of navigation links.

terms.title: Footer Tag
terms.definition: Defines a footer for a document or section.
terms.explanation: Typically contains copyright data, contact info, or sitemap links.

terms.title: Form
terms.definition: An HTML section used to collect user input.
terms.explanation: Contains interactive controls such as text boxes, checkboxes, and buttons.

terms.title: Input Tag
terms.definition: Used to create interactive controls for web forms to accept user data.
terms.explanation: Its behavior depends heavily on the value of its type attribute.

terms.title: Label Tag
terms.definition: Represents a caption for an item in a user interface interface.
terms.explanation: Improves usability and accessibility by associating text with form controls.

terms.title: Textarea Tag
terms.definition: Defines a multi-line text input control.
terms.explanation: Unlike standard inputs, textareas can hold an unlimited number of plain text characters.

terms.title: Select Tag
terms.definition: Used to create a drop-down list.
terms.explanation: Option elements inside the select element define the available choices.

terms.title: Option Tag
terms.definition: Defines an item in a select drop-down list.
terms.explanation: Nested inside a select, optgroup, or datalist element.

terms.title: Iframe Tag
terms.definition: An inline frame used to embed another document within the current document.
terms.explanation: Often used for embedding external content like maps, videos, or ads.

terms.title: Image Tag
terms.definition: Used to embed an image in an HTML page.
terms.explanation: It is a self-closing element requiring src and alt attributes.

terms.title: Audio Tag
terms.definition: Used to embed sound content in a document.
terms.explanation: Supports audio files like MP3, WAV, and OGG with built-in playback controls.

terms.title: Video Tag
terms.definition: Used to embed video content in a document.
terms.explanation: Supports options like autoplay, loop, controls, and poster images.

terms.title: Canvas Tag
terms.definition: Used to draw graphics dynamically via scripting (usually JavaScript).
terms.explanation: Acts as a transparent container for graphics rendering.

terms.title: SVG Tag
terms.definition: Defines vector-based graphics directly inside HTML.
terms.explanation: Scalable Vector Graphics maintain quality at any screen size or zoom level.

terms.title: Div Tag
terms.definition: Defines a generic block-level section or container in an HTML document.
terms.explanation: Has no semantic meaning by default; used primary for styling/grouping.

terms.title: Span Tag
terms.definition: An inline container used to group elements for styling purposes.
terms.explanation: Unlike div, span is an inline element and does not create line breaks.

terms.title: Unordered List
terms.definition: Defines a bulleted list of items.
terms.explanation: Created using the <ul> tag and filled with <li> tags.

terms.title: Ordered List
terms.definition: Defines a numbered/ordered list of items.
terms.explanation: Created using the <ol> tag and rendered with numerical or alphabetical markers.

terms.title: List Item Tag
terms.definition: Defines an item inside an ordered or unordered list.
terms.explanation: Must be contained within a parent <ul>, <ol>, or <menu> tag.

terms.title: Table Tag
terms.definition: Used to display data in a tabular format consisting of rows and columns.
terms.explanation: Composed of nested elements like <tr>, <td>, and <th>.

terms.title: Table Row Tag
terms.definition: Defines a row of cells in a table.
terms.explanation: Contains <td> or <th> tags inside an HTML table.

terms.title: Table Data Tag
terms.definition: Defines a standard data cell in an HTML table.
terms.explanation: Regular cell content inside a table row, aligned left by default.

terms.title: Meta Tags
terms.definition: Provides metadata about the HTML document.
terms.explanation: Metadata will not be displayed on the page, but is machine-parsable for SEO and browsers.

terms.title: Viewport Meta Tag
terms.definition: Gives instructions to the browser on how to control the page's dimensions and scaling.
terms.explanation: Essential for responsive web design on mobile devices.

terms.title: Head Tag
terms.definition: A container for metadata, links to scripts, and stylesheets.
terms.explanation: Contents inside the head tag are not rendered directly in the document body.

terms.title: Body Tag
terms.definition: Defines the main content body of an HTML document.
terms.explanation: Contains all visible contents of an HTML document such as text, images, and lists.

terms.title: Script Tag
terms.definition: Used to embed or reference executable code, usually JavaScript.
terms.explanation: Can contain inline scripts or point to an external file using the src attribute.

terms.title: Link Tag
terms.definition: Defines the relationship between the current document and an external resource.
terms.explanation: Most commonly used to link to external CSS style sheets.

terms.title: Style Tag
terms.definition: Used to contain internal CSS styles for a document.
terms.explanation: Styles declared here override external sheets if placed after them.

terms.title: Self-closing Tags
terms.definition: Tags that close themselves without requiring a separate end tag.
terms.explanation: Commonly written with a trailing slash in XHTML or void elements in HTML5.

terms.title: Entities
terms.definition: Characters reserved for HTML execution or not present on standard keyboards.
terms.explanation: Replaced by entity names or numbers starting with an ampersand.

terms.title: Data Attributes
terms.definition: Custom attributes starting with 'data-' to store extra user information.
terms.explanation: Allows embedding custom data onto standard HTML elements readable via JS.

terms.title: Aria Attributes
terms.definition: Accessible Rich Internet Applications attributes for enhancing accessibility.
terms.explanation: Helps assistive technologies understand element roles and dynamic content.

terms.title: Progress Tag
terms.definition: Represents the completion progress of a task.
terms.explanation: Renders a progress bar indicating how far along an action is.

terms.title: Meter Tag
terms.definition: Represents a scalar measurement within a known range or fractional value.
terms.explanation: Used for values like disk usage, relevancy, or test scores.

terms.title: Details Tag
terms.definition: Creates an interactive widget that the user can open and close.
terms.explanation: Often paired with the <summary> element to specify a visible heading.

terms.title: Summary Tag
terms.definition: Specifies a summary or caption for a details element disclosure box.
terms.explanation: Clicking this element toggles the visibility of the parent details box.

terms.title: Dialog Tag
terms.definition: Represents a modal or non-modal dialog box or interactive component.
terms.explanation: Includes native API support for open/close behaviors without major JavaScript dependency.

terms.title: Datalist Tag
terms.definition: Contains a set of option elements that represent suggested options for an input element.
terms.explanation: Provides an auto-complete feature for input fields.

terms.title: Template Tag
terms.definition: A mechanism for holding HTML content intended to be cloned and instantiated dynamically via JavaScript.
terms.explanation: Content inside template is parsed but not rendered when the page loads.
